ratings.comment: Pablo was very accesible outside of class and seemed to genuinely care about helping students succeed. When I asked for help and had questions, he explained things nicely and well (he wasn't condescending to me). His lectures can be a bit abstract and confusing sometimes, but if I asked questions, he was able to put it in simpler terms for me.
This is my second course taken with him, he is understanding and caring about situations, he's alwaya accessible during class or outside of class, he's nice and will help out anytime you need it

While I didn't find him as condescending as others, I can see where that comes from. I've never learned Spanish culture before- he was too abstract for me, often having us think deeply about topics but never making sure we understand/explaining surface level stuff. He doesn't make his exams criteria very clear, which makes them very stressful.

There's no reason an intro Spanish course should be this stressful and difficult, half of the students in my class were forced to drop the course due to him. He's incredibly condescending & rude for no reason, it's like is out to fail as many students as he can. Hard STEM classes were easier than this. Avoid him at all costs, I genuinely mean it!

The class has excessive daily homework and MANDATORY attendance and participation. Grading is extremely harsh. Condescending is the perfect word to describe his teaching. He singles out students and embarrasses them. After the first day the course content rapidly advanced, and he would get just as condescending if you could not "keep up".

I would never take a class with this professor again or ever recommend a class with him to anyone. He is extremely passive-aggressive and makes rude comments when you don't know something. He expects you to come to class knowing everything that the class is going over that day and is a very unfair grader. Do not take a class with him whatsoever.

Pablo knows how to speak spanish and is accessible outside of class but he is not an effective teacher or good at articulating expectations and concepts. He had a demeaning attitude when students didn't understand topics. His attitude this semester contributed to an overall very toxic learning experience. I would avoid this instructor in every way.
